scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: Everyone knows that when a relationship is bad, but often there's no way to make up your mind to leave. How would you advise those who can't let go?

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: If it's about this point, it's actually about unclear principles in life. The most important thing for a person...

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: ...is will, attitude, and ability. Attitude is your principle for dealing with people, your principle for life, and your principle for work.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: It's that you must understand your principles for choosing a partner.

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: Why can't you cut ties, or why do you get tangled up? It's because your principles are not clearly set.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: There's a saying: life is about going through eighty-one tribulations. God is also fair; he will give you plenty of pain.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: For example, he gives you this pain—the pain of a breakup or the pain of a scumbag. He gives it to you once; you meet a scumbag.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: Suppose next time you didn't learn; he gives it to you once more. Next time you still haven't learned; he gives it to you again.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: Until the day you set your principles in love, God will stop this pain.
